author: Edge
text:
Well starting tomorrow I have nothing left to hide behind. After
playing around and testing I have finalized my draft trading plan I
tend to use for the next 3 to 6 months to ascertain if I have the skills
 and mindset to trade the fund. If I can yield positive results, on my
live account over 6 months, I will hopefully be able to start trials to
ascertain if I have what it takes to trade the RTM fund.

My journey has taken me (3) long years of trial and error. And its only
been in the last (6) months that the methodologies have come together.
Understanding price is one thing, now its time to see if I have the
mental capacity.

I will be stepping away for the next little while to give it everything I
 can. I will still drop by, but I need to face my demons and give it
all.

Thanks to all my good friends here including Gregg Harry and Mertch.
(many others as well) Staurum, Aran and Alan, you are superstars and my
 friend Hoeschec good to see you back posting mate. You are a legend.

Last but not least, my very good friend IF. I love you like a brother. Its been insanely awesome getting to know you this year!

I will report back soon....
